content: Individuals with diabetes or prediabetes should be screened for a history of dieting and disordered eating behaviors during Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) sessions and Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) visits. Nutrition therapy should be tailored to address maladaptive eating behaviors, including disordered eating patterns or actions that may negatively impact diabetes management. Examples of such behaviors include overtreatment of hypoglycemia or intentionally reducing medication doses to manage hunger. If disordered eating behaviors are identified, it is recommended to refer the individual to a qualified behavioral health professional for further evaluation and support.
